reviewer: Claude Code (AI first-pass source audit; not an independent human curator)
scope: 1-based manifest positions 61-70 of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, frozen order; 10 candidates, 28 arms
blinding: self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model output NOT opened. FRDB snapshot (SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a verified) read only after dropping every column containing 'cmax'; arms mapped by AUC / t1/2 / n / application & population comments. No arm selected by outcome.
method_note: Single AI pass. Sources: PubMed/Europe PMC abstracts, PMC full text via Europe PMC XML, PMDA IF PDF. Wiley, Springer, Nature and PMC-PDF endpoints returned bot challenges/403 or paywalls; browser automation deliberately not used (avoid writing .playwright-mcp). No email-requiring API used. IR not inferred from oral route. Ineligibility calls based on abstracts are explicit in each reason.
unresolved_issues: Sarpogrelate frdb_4227: FRDB labels the IR arm 300 mg single, source regimen is 100 mg x3 q6h; ruled ineligible from abstract.
Dopamine frdb_5735: source is a levodopa study (dosed parent mismatch); FRDB row likely a mis-annotated levodopa or metabolite row.
Apratastat frdb_6947/6948: FRDB points to Table III 'LPS-Challenge Study'; if confirmed, likely ineligible (endotoxin-challenged).
Fenclofenac 6581: abstract value 63.5+/-4.6 ug/mL (600 mg) noted but unverified (formulation/fasting unknown).

Paywalled originals needing library retrieval: Choi 1993 Biopharm Drug Dispos (fadrozole), Li 2020 CPDD (CC-122), Shu 2011 J Clin Pharmacol (apratastat), Ellis 2015 Spinal Cord (capromorelin), Henson 1980 EJDMP (fenclofenac).

arms.reason: Abstract confirms 12 mg single oral fadrozole HCl, 12-h fast, 9 healthy male+female volunteers, randomized fed/fasted crossover; FRDB n=9 consistent. Full text (Biopharm Drug Dispos 1993) inaccessible (Wiley 403 challenge; Semantic Scholar CLOSED), so dosage form, matrix, statistic and Cmax table not seen. Not inferring IR from oral route.
arms.population: healthy male and female volunteers, n=9

arms.reason: Arm is the IR reference (FRDB t1/2 0.7 h, 'Immediate release' match abstract), but the IR regimen was 100 mg given three times at 6-h intervals with sampling over 24 h after the first dose - not a single 300 mg dose as the manifest dose implies. Multiple-dose regimen; Cmax not attributable to a single 300 mg IR dose. Full text not accessible (Wiley 403) to check whether a first-dose-only 100 mg Cmax exists; even so it would not match the frozen 300 mg arm.
arms.exact_locator: Kim et al. J Clin Pharm Ther 2014 abstract (Methods)
arms.dose_evidence: 100 mg x3 at 6-h intervals (not 300 mg single)

arms.reason: Cited IF revision (_160_) returns HTTP 404; values taken from current Anplag interview form rev.18 (Dec 2025, _180_). Section VII.1(2): healthy adult males n=30, new small film-coated tablet 50 mg, single oral dose under fasting; plasma unchanged sarpogrelate. FRDB AUC 0.2908 ug*h/mL and t1/2 0.753 h and n=30 match the table exactly. The manufacturer interview form documents film-coated tablets and >=80% dissolution within 30 min, supporting immediate release. The nominal sarpogrelate hydrochloride dose follows the frozen P0 salt-dose convention. The cited older revision is unavailable, but current manufacturer/PMDA rev.18 has the exact AUC/t1/2/n mapping and the PDF page image confirms μg/mL (the text layer misreads μ as m).
arms.exact_locator: Anplag IF rev.18 (Dec 2025), PDF p.25/printed -25-, VII.1(2) first table; formulation p.14; dissolution p.17

arms.reason: Cited source (Robertson et al. Br J Clin Pharmacol 1989) is a LEVODOPA study: 250 mg oral levodopa (alone and with carbidopa) in young and elderly volunteers. Dopamine was not the dosed drug; a dopamine/levodopa analyte row at 250 mg cannot represent the dosed parent. Fails the dosed-parent identity check. PMC full text (PMC1379971) was bot-challenged, so only the abstract was read; the abstract is sufficient for the parent-identity exclusion.
